response: Low birth weight is not a reliable risk indicator for congenital cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection. According to the available data, low birth weight and small head circumference at birth failed to predict congenital CMV infection. Instead, CMV-DNA detection in umbilical cord blood at the time of delivery using real-time PCR is recommended as a decisive, rapid, and non-invasive test to identify congenitally infected newborns.
